title: JANUS Engine R0M2 — Cu/Brass Axle magnetic-field metrology gate
purpose: Measure the complete magnetic signature of the rotating Axle and quantify how copper versus brass structural conductors alter field distribution, eddy drag, heat and magnetic-drive efficiency.
frozen_questions: What are Bx, By, Bz and |B| at the AFPM gap, chamber wall, POMS boundary and outside housing at each operating RPM?
How much of the rotating field is static PM field versus current-driven stator field versus induced eddy-current reaction field?
Does copper increase drag/heating enough to disqualify it as the structural Axle material compared with brass?
Do EPM switching pulses create unacceptable dB/dt, eddy heating or EMI in the conductive Axle/chamber?
Is stray field low enough for nearby sensors, control electronics and PEMFC instrumentation?

test_matrix.repeat_rule: same geometry, same air gap, same magnet set, same probe positions, same temperature window

derived_metrics: field phase shift / attenuation between material cases
incremental drive watts at equal RPM
energy per EPM pulse and associated field transient

material_decision_logic.brass_preference_condition: Prefer a corrosion-qualified brass/DZR-brass-class structural solution if it materially reduces eddy drag/heating versus copper without unacceptable corrosion, strength or wear penalty.
material_decision_logic.copper_preference_condition: Use copper structurally only if measured electromagnetic penalty is negligible or if its thermal/electrical advantage provides a larger independently measured system benefit.
material_decision_logic.segmentation_option: If either conductor shows excessive closed-loop eddy current, test geometric/electrical segmentation to interrupt circulating-current paths before abandoning the material.

pass_criteria.no_unbudgeted_field: all measured magnetic-drive and eddy-current watts are included in the JANUS auxiliary budget
pass_criteria.thermal: no progressive temperature rise inconsistent with the declared steady-state thermal sink
pass_criteria.field_stability: field waveform and phase are repeatable at fixed RPM/current within declared uncertainty
pass_criteria.material: selected Axle material passes electromagnetic plus water-chemistry/corrosion/mechanical criteria
pass_criteria.self_drive_boundary: magnetic losses are charged before any battery-neutral or surplus-generation claim

explicit_nonclaims: No numerical tesla value is claimed before the magnet geometry/grade, pole count, air gap and current are frozen or measured.
Skin-depth calculations are screening calculations, not a substitute for FEA or hardware measurement.
Copper/brass conductivity alone does not determine total eddy-current loss.
next_gate_after_pass: R0M3_FIELD_AWARE_AFPM_EPM_CONTROL: use measured B(theta,t), torque and loss maps to optimize commutation, EPM timing and battery startup energy.
